Class.summary: Controller responsible for managing communication and comments on support tickets.

Constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class.
Constructor.param: The service used to obtain the current authenticated user's ID and role.

GetComments.summary: Retrieves a chronological list of comments for a specific support ticket.
GetComments.remarks: Access is restricted using ticket ownership rules: Admins can view comments on any ticket; Agents can view comments on assigned tickets; Customers can view comments on their own tickets.
GetComments.param: The unique identifier (GUID) of the ticket.
GetComments.returns: A list of comment response DTOs including author display names and timestamps.
GetComments.response: Returns the comments for the ticket.
If the user is not authenticated.
If the ticket does not exist or caller lacks access permission.

AddComment.summary: Adds a new comment to a support ticket.
AddComment.remarks: Only users with access to the ticket (Admin, Assigned Agent, or Ticket Owner Customer) can add comments. Adding a comment automatically logs a CommentAdded activity event.
AddComment.param: The unique identifier (GUID) of the ticket.
AddComment.returns: A confirmation response indicating the comment was added.
AddComment.response: If the comment content is empty or exceeds length limits.
If the user is not authenticated.
If the ticket does not exist or caller lacks access permission.
